changes.title: Lindsey Graham's Sister to Serve the Rest of His Senate Term
changes.summary: New details are emerging about the final moments of the late Sen. Lindsey Graham and what may have been his final phone call. It comes as his sister, Darline Graham Nordone, prepares to take the oath of office to serve the rest of her brother’s term, which ends in January. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

changes.title: S.C. Gov McMaster appoints Darline Graham Nordone to fill Sen. Lindsey Graham's seat
changes.summary: South Carolina Governor Henry McMaster appoints Darline Graham Nordone, Sen. Lindsey Graham's younger sister, to serve the remainder of the late Republican senator's term, which ends early January 2027.

changes.title: Who is Darline Graham Nordone, the late Sen. Lindsey Graham's sister?
changes.summary: Nordone, who was appointed to serve the remaining months of the Senate term that her brother left behind when he died over the weekend, hasn't been in office before.

changes.title: Trump recommends South Carolina’s governor appoint Lindsey Graham’s sister to finish his Senate term
changes.summary: President Donald Trump said Monday that he has recommended to South Carolina Gov. Henry McMaster that he choose Lindsey Graham’s sister, Darline Graham Nordone, to serve the remainder of the late Republican senator’s term, which ends in early January.
